environment: Google Apps Script, bound to Google Sheets
source: Initial Google Sheets provider CSV with supported keyed-provider cases replaced by sanitized Apps Script report exports
limitations: Selected symbols and implemented fields only; PARSED does not establish independent financial accuracy.
The report combines provider downloads from different times and diagnostic commits, recorded in source evidence files.
HTML source quote timestamps are unknown.
Google website price/yield extraction failures and invalid-name false positive remain.
Alpha dates are preserved as date-only or provider-local strings; no UTC offset is inferred.
Twelve Data timestamp identifies interval opening, not the last price update.
